positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Mentoring, guiding and providing support for a team of 3 software engineers and 2 QA engineers.
- Planning and utilizing resources effectively to deliver quality software on time.
- Traveling to different customer sites to provide hands-on debugging, architecting, and support.
- Utilized icecc to improve build time from 1.5 hours to 20 minutes (over 75%).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Cross compiling and delivering an SDK to different automotive manufacturers.
- Working in teams in an Agile environment to translate requirements to productions.
- Designed and developed software in C++ for in-vehicle infotainment system.
- Utilized Google Assistant, and Alexa SDK to develop a voice recognition smart feature for an android
multimedia system.
- Utilized Qt, Jni, and third-party libraries to design and develop the graphical user interface.

projects.title: Project Water Buddy
projects.description:
- Collaborate with 3 other engineering students under advising of CalPlug/Calit2 faculty
- Successfully  design and manufacture a proof of concept for a smart water dispenser that can save energy
- The machine saves 50% of the annual electrical bill under testing environment

projects.title: SMART IOT
projects.description:
- Lead a team of 5 students to design and develop a machine learning server to control IOT devices
- Assign specific tasks to other members, plan and arrange weekly meeting
- Successfully developed and assembled a prototype using ESP8266 and Arduino
